entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: One of the main vampire bloodlines on Innistrad, concentrated in Stensia.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region where the Falkenrath line is concentrated.

entities.name: Castle Falkenrath
entities.description: Gothic castle in the Geier Reach housing Falkenrath vampires; destroyed by Avacyn.

entities.name: Geier Reach
entities.description: Region of Stensia containing Castle Falkenrath.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose return and emergence from the Helvault led angels to strike the Falkenrath.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose corruption changed the Falkenrath into batlike monsters.

entities.name: Anje Falkenrath
entities.description: Particularly old Falkenrath scion who leads a hunting pack and wants to reclaim Castle Falkenrath.

entities.name: Heron's Grace
entities.description: Monastery founded on the ruins of Castle Falkenrath.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel whose protection followed Avacyn's return.

events.summary: Avacyn destroyed Castle Falkenrath, scattering the bloodline.
events.quote: Avacyn destroyed Castle Falkenrath during the events of Shadows Over Innistrad

events.summary: Emrakul's corruption changed the Falkenrath into batlike monsters.
events.quote: the corruption changed them into batlike monsters

events.summary: Anje Falkenrath gathered a hunting pack to reclaim Castle Falkenrath from the monks.
events.quote: she wants to reclaim Castle Falkenrath from the monks who live there

relations.quote: a particularly old scion of the family named Anje Falkenrath
